name: Edge-Radar: Weekly Odds API Key Probe
description: Probes each Odds API key's remaining quota, so a drained or dead key shows up before a scan needs it. One request per key. Default Sunday 22:00 UTC (6 PM US Eastern in summer). Needs a clone of ai-automation-tools/edge-radar on the machine the task runs on, with its .venv and a .env holding your Kalshi and Odds API keys (python scripts/doctor.py checks both).

parameters.label: Edge-Radar clone
parameters.help: Absolute path to your clone, e.g. C:\Users\you\edge-radar. Its .venv and .env are used.

author: ai-automation-tools
